s0.ru: Отсчётов {n}: {values}. Каждая клетка становится наибольшим числом среди себя и двух соседей. За краем стоит 0. Какова последняя клетка?
s0.en: There are {n} readings: {values}. Each cell becomes the largest number among itself and its two neighbors. Beyond an edge there is 0. What is the last cell?

s1.en: There are {n} readings: {values}. Each cell becomes the largest number among itself and its two neighbors. Beyond an edge there is 0. How many cells became larger than they were?
